(Ponchatoula, Louisiana) | college = [[Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball|Santa Clara]] (2025–2026) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * [[West Coast Conference|WCC]] Freshman of the Year (2026) * WCC Sixth Man of the Year (2026) * First-team All-WCC (2026) * WCC All-Freshman Team (2026) * [[Louisiana Mr. Basketball]] (2024) }} '''Allen Graves''' (born July 28, 2006) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball|Santa Clara Broncos]]. == High school career == Graves attended [[Ponchatoula High School]] in Louisiana. He averaged 12 points, eight rebounds, and two assists per game as a sophomore. As a junior, Graves averaged a [[double-double]] with 20 points and 15 rebounds and led his team to a Division 1 non-select state championship title. In the championship game, he posted 23 points and 16 rebounds and was named Most Outstanding Player.{{Cite web |date=2023-11-08 |title=Allen Graves Signs With Men's Basketball |url=https://santaclarabroncos.com/news/2023/11/8/allen-graves-signs-with-Bronco-mbb.aspx |access-date=2026-04-15 |website=Santa Clara University |language=en}} As a senior, Graves averaged 20.9 points and 12.1 rebounds, leading his team to a 30–4 record. In the state championship game, Graves posted 19 points and 20 rebounds en route to a second consecutive title.{{Cite web |date=2024-03-21 |title=Men's Hoops Signee Allen Graves Named Louisiana Gatorade POTY |url=https://santaclarabroncos.com/news/2024/3/21/mens-basketball-mens-hoops-signee-allen-graves-named-louisiana-gatorade-poty.aspx |access-date=2026-04-15 |website=Santa Clara University |language=en}} He was named the 2023–24 Gatorade Louisiana Boys Basketball Player of the Year{{Cite web |title=Allen Graves Gatorade 2023 - 2024: Player of the Year Boys Basketball - Louisiana PLAYER OF THE YEAR |url=https://playeroftheyear.gatorade.com/winner/Allen-Graves/40227 |archive-url=http://web.archive.org/web/20260124234125/https://playeroftheyear.gatorade.com/winner/Allen-Graves/40227 |archive-date=2026-01-24 |access-date=2026-04-15 |website=playeroftheyear.gatorade.com |language=en}} as well as [[Louisiana Mr. Basketball]].{{Cite web |last=LSWA |date=2024-04-07 |title=Ponchatoula's Allen Graves named Louisiana Mr. Basketball |url=https://crescentcitysports.com/ponchatoulas-allen-graves-named-louisiana-mr-basketball/ |access-date=2026-04-15 |website=Crescent City Sports |language=en-US}} == College career == After [[Redshirt (college sports)|redshirting]] in 2024–25, Graves played all 35 games for Santa Clara in 2025–26. On February 7, 2026, he scored a season-high 30 points and 13 rebounds in a 96–92 win over [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State]].{{Cite web |date=2026-02-07 |title=Graves' Career Night Helps Broncos Hold Off Washington State |url=https://santaclarabroncos.com/news/2026/2/7/mens-basketball-graves-career-night-helps-broncos-hold-off-washington-state.aspx |access-date=2026-04-15 |website=Santa Clara University |language=en}} As a freshman, Graves averaged 11.8 points and leading the team with 6.5 rebounds per game. He also tallied a total of 67 steals, tied for the most among freshmen in D1 with [[Tounde Yessoufou]] and the most by a freshman in program history.{{Cite web |title=Allen Graves - 2025-26 - Men's Basketball |url=https://santaclarabroncos.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/allen--graves/9118 |access-date=2026-04-15 |website=Santa Clara University |language=en}} Graves was named the [[West Coast Conference|WCC]]'s Freshman of the Year and Sixth Man of the Year.{{Cite web |date=2026-03-03 |title=West Coast Conference Announces 2025-26 Men's Basketball All-Conference Awards
